name: Shenzhen VMAX New Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen VMAX New Energy Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, production, and sale, and technical services business in the new energy vehicle field in China and internationally. The company offers motor controllers, electric drive assemblies, electric vehicle communication controllers, and liquid-cooled charging pile modules, as well as on-board chargers, on-board DC/DC converters, integrated on-board power supply products, and electric drive system services. It also provides electric vehicle charging systems, including on-board chargers, combined charging units, and DC-DC (Buck and Boost); electronic vehicle electric drive system, including motor controller, 3-in-1 drive system unit,…
